periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, with the superior pole inclined medially toward the sagittal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering, with the visual distance from the geometric center to the lowest point exceeding the distance to the superior boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High lateral thickness, where the dark band occupies approximately 45 percent of the visible vertical torso height at the shoulder.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna distance is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, uniformly convex semicircular curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.
